Login.title: DataGuard
Login.subtitle: Data center audit operations
Login.heading: Sign in
Login.description: Use your operator account to continue.

Settings.title: Application Settings
Settings.description: Customize application branding and Telegram notification templates.

DeviceGroups.pageDescription: Group devices by responsible PIC so a whole group shares one owner. Devices bind to a group, PICs inherit from the group.
DeviceGroups.emptyDescription: Create a group, then bind devices to it.
DeviceGroups.deleteConfirm: Delete group "{name}"? Devices stay, membership is removed.
DeviceGroups.modalDescription: Bind devices to this group; owners inherit from it.

Incidents.title: Incidents
Incidents.description: Track and manage data center incidents

Epdr.readOnlyHint: dc-check only reads data from WatchGuard. It never sends commands or changes anything there.

setup.title: Connect WatchGuard for {site}
setup.body: Once connected, this page shows every protected device, what needs attention, and any threats found.
setup.steps: Enter account details|Test the connection|Turn it on
setup.askAdmin: Ask a superadmin to connect WatchGuard for this site.
setup.disabledBody: Data stops updating while the connection is paused.
setup.firstSyncTitle: Waiting for the first successful sync
setup.firstSyncBody: No completed device sync has been recorded yet. Activating the connection does not start the background worker. Ask your administrator to check the watchguard-worker service and its logs; this screen cannot confirm that it is running.
setup.refreshHint: Checks the saved status every 15 seconds for up to five minutes. This does not start a WatchGuard sync; refresh manually after that.
setup.emptyInventory: The device sync completed successfully, but returned no devices for this account.
setup.errorBody: The last sync failed or was incomplete. Ask your administrator to check the watchguard-worker logs and connection settings. Any data shown may be out of date.
setup.staleBody: The last successful sync was {time}. The numbers below may be out of date.

endpoints.title: Endpoint Security
endpoints.description: Protection status of every device WatchGuard manages at this site.
endpoints.needsAttention: {count, plural, one {# device needs attention} other {# devices need attention}}
endpoints.fleetMapHint: One square per device. Hover for the name, select to open details.

bucketHint.outdated: Protected, but the engine or threat database is not up to date.
bucketHint.disabled: Someone or something switched protection off. This device is exposed.
bucketHint.error: Protection is installed but reports a fault. Usually fixed by repairing protection in WatchGuard Cloud.
bucketHint.install_error: The protection agent failed to install on this device.
bucketHint.no_license: No WatchGuard license is assigned to this device.
bucketHint.unknown: WatchGuard returned a status dc-check does not recognise yet.

nextStep.outdated: Wait for the next update cycle. If it persists, check the device's internet access.
nextStep.disabled: Turn protection back on in WatchGuard Cloud, or ask the device owner why it was disabled.
nextStep.error: In WatchGuard Cloud, open this device and run Repair protection. dc-check cannot do this automatically.
nextStep.install_error: Re-run the WatchGuard installer on this device, or check the install error in WatchGuard Cloud.
nextStep.no_license: Assign a license in WatchGuard Cloud, or remove the device if it is retired.
nextStep.unknown: Check this device in WatchGuard Cloud.

drawer.criticalHint: Critical devices always need approval before any action.
drawer.noAutoHint: Every future action on this device will wait for a person.
drawer.assetHint: Optional. Linking connects this device to its DataGuard asset record.
drawer.assetSearch: Search asset name, IP or code
drawer.readOnlyNote: Only site admins can change these settings.

threats.title: Threats
threats.description: Malware and suspicious activity WatchGuard found at this site.
threats.clearBody: Nothing that needs handling in the last 30 days.
threats.active: {count, plural, one {# threat needs handling} other {# threats need handling}}
threats.activeBody: Each one is tracked as an Incident. Open it to follow up.
threats.trendEmpty: No detections in the last 30 days.
threats.ignoredHint: Stored for review but not turned into incidents.

categoryHint.malware: Malicious software such as trojans or ransomware.
categoryHint.pup: Potentially unwanted programs, usually adware or bundled tools.
categoryHint.exploit: An attempt to abuse a software weakness.
categoryHint.ioa: Indicator of attack: behaviour that looks like an intrusion in progress.
categoryHint.other: A category WatchGuard reported that dc-check does not classify.

settings.title: WatchGuard connection
settings.description: Connect each site to its own WatchGuard account. dc-check only reads from WatchGuard.
settings.siteListHint: Pick a site to set up or change its connection.
settings.regionHint: Where your WatchGuard account is hosted.
settings.accountHint: Starts with WGC-. You can find it in WatchGuard Cloud.
settings.credentialsBody: These stay encrypted on the server and are never shown again.
settings.apiKeyHint: A shared key from WatchGuard Cloud.
settings.roHint: Used for everything right now, since dc-check only reads data.
settings.rwHint: Not used yet — saved for a future update. Keep it in the Advanced section.
settings.stored: Saved — enter a new value to change it
settings.testFail: Some checks failed — see the list.
settings.testHint: dc-check checks login, account, device data and threat data separately.
settings.activateTitle: Turn on & set how often to refresh
settings.syncHint: How often dc-check reads fresh data from WatchGuard.
settings.enableHint: Data only stays fresh while the connection is enabled.
settings.doneBody: WatchGuard data will now appear on the Endpoint Security and Threats pages.

global.title: Global safeguards
global.description: These apply to every site. They stay mostly untouched.
global.killSwitchHint: When on, dc-check will not change anything on WatchGuard. Reading still works.
global.allowedHint: What a site may be allowed to do. Everything is currently read-only.
global.hourlyCapLabel: Max actions per site per hour
global.simMinDaysHint: How long a rule must run in simulation before automatic mode is allowed.

detection.title: Detection & safeguards
detection.description: What WatchGuard signals become incidents at this site, and how aggressively dc-check may act.
detection.eventsHint: Which findings become incidents. Malware, unwanted programs and exploits are the usual ones.
detection.scoreHint: Only ThreatSync incidents between these scores are turned into incidents.
detection.correlationHint: Findings for the same device and threat inside this window join one incident.
detection.reopenHint: A repeat of the same threat inside this window reopens the old incident.
detection.killSwitchHint: When on, no automated action runs at this site.
detection.breakerHint: Stops automation for the site if too much happens at once.
detection.healthHint: Track devices whose protection is disabled or failing.
